name: Fiskmas
description: Hosting for AI agents: your AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) creates projects, pushes Docker images, and deploys them to live HTTPS URLs over MCP. One API token is both the MCP credential and the docker login for registry.fiskmas.dev.
author: Peter Frank

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the identity of the current token holder (account + provider) plus its subscription plan (free | plus) and the plan's limits: max running projects, per-project memory/CPU caps, log windows, and the project-database fair-use guide. Free plans include an upgrade_url for Plus ($9.99/mo: 5 projects, 512 MB / 1 CPU per project, always-on).

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Start onboarding: require an email, create a pending account, and email a human verify link. Does NOT return an API token. The human must click the link; the verify page shows the token once. Then configure Authorization: Bearer <token> on this MCP client (also docker login -u <token> registry.fiskmas.dev). If you already have a token, call whoami instead.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Poll onboarding state for an email (pending | active | unknown). Use after create_account while waiting for the human to verify.

tools.name: reissue_token
tools.description: Re-issue the API token for an existing account. Provide the email the account was registered with; Fiskmås emails a fresh one-time verify link to that address. The human clicks it; the verify page shows the new token once (old tokens are revoked immediately). This is the self-service recovery path when a token was lost, rotated, or is being rejected as "invalid or expired". It does not create a new account — for a brand-new account use create_account. Rate-limited: a few requests per hour per email.

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Delete the caller's account. Stops and removes all projects (containers, routes, MariaDB) first, then deletes the account. Refuses to leave orphaned runtimes.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project and reserve <slug>-app.fiskmas.dev. Slug must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,48}$ and is not reserved. Subject to the plan's running-project quota (Free: 1, Plus: 5) — on quota the error tells the human how to upgrade or free a slot.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the caller's projects with status and URL.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch a single project by id or slug.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Stop and delete a project. Its slug goes into quarantine for 7 days: you may re-use it immediately, other accounts get a 409 until it is freed.

tools.name: set_env
tools.description: Set environment variables on a project. Requires a restart before they take effect.

tools.name: list_env
tools.description: List a project's env keys with masked values (never returns full secrets).

tools.name: deploy_project
tools.description: Pull an image by digest and run one container with the plan's cpu/memory caps (Free: 256 MB / 0.2 CPU, Plus: 512 MB / 1 CPU). Only registry.fiskmas.dev images are accepted. Rate-limited to 1 deploy per 5 minutes per account (429 with a retry-seconds hint); use restart_project for a transient crash - it does not count against the limit. Re-deploying a running project is always allowed; starting a second one on Free is blocked until one stops.

tools.name: start_project
tools.description: Start a stopped project's container.

tools.name: stop_project
tools.description: Stop a running project's container (keep the image).

tools.name: restart_project
tools.description: Restart a running project's container.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Return project status, url, image digest, and last deploy error.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Return recent container log lines. `tail` = line count (plan default 200; plan max 2000), `since` = time window in seconds (plan window: free 24 h, plus 7 d — logs are live-pod streams, not stored history). When both are given, `since` wins.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Account-wide or per-project stats for debugging: live CPU/mem vs the plan caps (Free: 256 MB / 0.2 CPU, Plus: 512 MB / 1 CPU) and deploy history. Omit `project` for all of the caller's projects; pass a project id or slug for a single project. The account rollup also reports the plan and per-project caps. With `project` + `since`, also returns `resources.history` — per-project CPU/mem time series over the window (sampled every ~30 s on the k3s platform; absent on stacks without the metrics collector).

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem with the Fiskmås toolset so it can be fixed. Use it when a tool errored or misbehaved, you got stuck and can't proceed, or the instructions/skill were unclear. Do NOT use it for praise. kind=bug means it broke, kind=suggestion means it was unclear or could be better, kind=other is anything else that didn't work. Name the `tool` and, if relevant, the `project`. At most one call per session.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the platform skills available to the caller.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Return the bytes of a platform skill by name.
